Description

There are two cricket pitches at Streatham & Marlborough Cricket Club, which is based just by Dulwich Common. It also has and 3 lanes of artificial nets, a pavilion which is open during match / training days, and on site parking.

The Clubhouse bar is open on match days, training days and occasionally in the winter. All members are welcome to use the net facilities whenever they are free.

The pitches are easy to get from by car and also public transport, being based near Forest Hill Overground station.
